description: This file defines an interface FavoriteDao which serves as a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing favorite recipes in a local database, utilizing Room persistence library annotations and methods for querying, inserting, and deleting favorite recipe data.

classes.name: FavoriteDao
classes.description: Interface annotated with @Dao for Room persistence to manage favorite recipes in local database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of all favorite recipes stored in the database.

methods.name: getAllOnce
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all favorite recipes without LiveData, suspending until the data is available.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a recipe with the specified id exists in the favorites database.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Inserts or updates a favorite recipe into the database, replacing on conflict.

methods.name: removeById
methods.description: Deletes a favorite recipe from the database based on its id.
